verses.original: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὁ μὴ εἰσερχόμενος διὰ τῆς θύρας εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τῶν προβάτων ἀλλὰ ἀναβαίνων ἀλλαχόθεν ἐκεῖνος κλέπτης ἐστὶν καὶ λῃστής
verses.transliteration: Amēn amēn legō hymin ho mē eiserchomenos dia tēs thyras eis tēn aulēn tōn probatōn alla anabainōn allachothen ekeinos kleptēs estin kai lēstēs
verses.literal: Truly truly I tell you whoever does not enter . . . the sheepfold by the gate but climbs in some other way is a thief and a robber
verses.literalPt: NA verdade, na verdade vos digo que aquele que não entra pela porta no curral das ovelhas, mas sobe por outra parte, é ladrão e salteador.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ εἰσερχόμενος διὰ τῆς θύρας ποιμήν ἐστιν τῶν προβάτων
verses.transliteration: ho de eiserchomenos dia tēs thyras poimēn estin tōn probatōn
verses.literal: But the one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep
verses.literalPt: Aquele, porém, que entra pela porta é o pastor das ovelhas.

verses.original: τούτῳ ὁ θυρωρὸς ἀνοίγει καὶ τὰ πρόβατα τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούει καὶ τὰ ἴδια πρόβατα φωνεῖ κατ’ ὄνομα καὶ ἐξάγει αὐτά
verses.transliteration: toutō ho thyrōros anoigei kai ta probata tēs phōnēs autou akouei kai ta idia probata phōnei kat’ onoma kai exagei auta
verses.literal: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him and the sheep listen for his voice He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out . . .
verses.literalPt: A este o porteiro abre, e as ovelhas ouvem a sua voz, e chama pelo nome às suas ovelhas, e as traz para fora.

verses.original: Ὅταν τὰ ἴδια πάντα ἐκβάλῃ ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν πορεύεται καὶ τὰ πρόβατα αὐτῷ ἀκολουθεῖ ὅτι οἴδασιν τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hotan ta idia panta ekbalē emprosthen autōn poreuetai kai ta probata autō akolouthei hoti oidasin tēn phōnēn autou
verses.literal: When he has brought out all his own he goes on ahead of them and his sheep follow him because they know his voice
verses.literalPt: E, quando tira para fora as suas ovelhas, vai adiante delas, e as ovelhas o seguem, porque conhecem a sua voz.

verses.original: ἀλλοτρίῳ δὲ οὐ μὴ ἀκολουθήσουσιν ἀλλὰ φεύξονται ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ὅτι οὐκ οἴδασιν τῶν ἀλλοτρίων τὴν φωνήν
verses.transliteration: allotriō de ou mē akolouthēsousin alla pheuxontai ap’ autou hoti ouk oidasin tōn allotriōn tēn phōnēn
verses.literal: But they will never follow a stranger in fact they will flee from him because they do not recognize his voice . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas de modo nenhum seguirão o estranho, antes fugirão dele, porque não conhecem a voz dos estranhos.

verses.original: Ταύτην τὴν παροιμίαν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐκεῖνοι δὲ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τίνα ἦν ἃ ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Tautēn tēn paroimian eipen autois ho Iēsous ekeinoi de ouk egnōsan tina ēn ha elalei autois
verses.literal: Jesus spoke to them using this illustration but they did not understand what - He was telling them
verses.literalPt: Jesus disse-lhes esta parábola; mas eles não entenderam o que era que lhes dizia.

verses.original: Εἶπεν οὖν πάλιν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ θύρα τῶν προβάτων
verses.transliteration: Eipen oun palin autois ho Iēsous Amēn amēn legō hymin hoti egō eimi hē thyra tōn probatōn
verses.literal: So He said to them again Truly truly I tell you I am the gate for the sheep
verses.literalPt: Tornou, pois, Jesus a dizer-lhes: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo que eu sou a porta das ovelhas.

verses.original: πάντες ὅσοι ἦλθον πρὸ ἐμοῦ κλέπται εἰσὶν καὶ λῃσταί ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἤκουσαν αὐτῶν τὰ πρόβατα
verses.transliteration: pantes hosoi ēlthon pro emou kleptai eisin kai lēstai all’ ouk ēkousan autōn ta probata
verses.literal: All who came before Me were thieves and robbers but the sheep did not listen to them
verses.literalPt: Todos quantos vieram antes de mim são ladrões e salteadores; mas as ovelhas não os ouviram.

verses.original: ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ θύρα δι’ ἐμοῦ ἐάν τις εἰσέλθῃ σωθήσεται καὶ εἰσελεύσεται καὶ ἐξελεύσεται καὶ νομὴν εὑρήσει
verses.transliteration: egō eimi hē thyra di’ emou ean tis eiselthē sōthēsetai kai eiseleusetai kai exeleusetai kai nomēn heurēsei
verses.literal: I am the gate If anyone enters through Me he will be saved He will come in and go out and find pasture
verses.literalPt: Eu sou a porta; se alguém entrar por mim, salvar-se-á, e entrará, e sairá, e achará pastagens.

verses.original: ὁ κλέπτης οὐκ ἔρχεται εἰ μὴ ἵνα κλέψῃ καὶ θύσῃ καὶ ἀπολέσῃ ἐγὼ ἦλθον ἵνα ζωὴν ἔχωσιν καὶ περισσὸν ἔχωσιν
verses.transliteration: ho kleptēs ouk erchetai ei mē hina klepsē kai thysē kai apolesē egō ēlthon hina zōēn echōsin kai perisson echōsin
verses.literal: The thief comes only . . . to steal and kill and destroy I have come that they may have life and have it in all its fullness
verses.literalPt: O ladrão não vem senão a roubar, a matar, e a destruir; eu vim para que tenham vida, e a tenham com abundância.

verses.original: Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλός ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλὸς τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ τίθησιν ὑπὲρ τῶν προβάτων
verses.transliteration: Egō eimi ho poimēn ho kalos ho poimēn ho kalos tēn psychēn autou tithēsin hyper tōn probatōn
verses.literal: I am the good shepherd The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep
verses.literalPt: Eu sou o bom Pastor; o bom Pastor dá a sua vida pelas ovelhas.

verses.original: ὁ μισθωτὸς καὶ οὐκ ὢν ποιμήν οὗ οὐκ ἔστιν τὰ πρόβατα ἴδια θεωρεῖ τὸν λύκον ἐρχόμενον καὶ ἀφίησιν τὰ πρόβατα καὶ φεύγει καὶ ὁ λύκος ἁρπάζει αὐτὰ καὶ σκορπίζει
verses.transliteration: ho misthōtos kai ouk ōn poimēn hou ouk estin ta probata idia theōrei ton lykon erchomenon kai aphiēsin ta probata kai pheugei kai ho lykos harpazei auta kai skorpizei
verses.literal: The hired hand is not the shepherd and the sheep are not his own When he sees the wolf coming he abandons the sheep and runs away Then the wolf pounces on them and scatters the flock
verses.literalPt: Mas o mercenário, e o que não é pastor, de quem não são as ovelhas, vê vir o lobo, e deixa as ovelhas, e foge; e o lobo as arrebata e dispersa as ovelhas.

verses.original: ὅτι μισθωτός ἐστιν καὶ οὐ μέλει αὐτῷ περὶ τῶν προβάτων
verses.transliteration: hoti misthōtos estin kai ou melei autō peri tōn probatōn
verses.literal: The man runs away because he is a hired servant and is unconcerned . . . for the sheep
verses.literalPt: Ora, o mercenário foge, porque é mercenário, e não tem cuidado das ovelhas.

verses.original: Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλός καὶ γινώσκω τὰ ἐμὰ καὶ γινώσκουσί με τὰ ἐμά
verses.transliteration: Egō eimi ho poimēn ho kalos kai ginōskō ta ema kai ginōskousi me ta ema
verses.literal: I am the good shepherd I know My sheep and My sheep . . . know Me
verses.literalPt: Eu sou o bom Pastor, e conheço as minhas ovelhas, e das minhas sou conhecido.

verses.original: καθὼς γινώσκει με ὁ Πατὴρ κἀγὼ γινώσκω τὸν Πατέρα καὶ τὴν ψυχήν μου τίθημι ὑπὲρ τῶν προβάτων
verses.transliteration: kathōs ginōskei me ho Patēr kagō ginōskō ton Patera kai tēn psychēn mou tithēmi hyper tōn probatōn
verses.literal: just as the Father knows Me and I know the Father And I lay down My life for the sheep
verses.literalPt: Assim como o Pai me conhece a mim, também eu conheço o Pai, e dou a minha vida pelas ovelhas.

verses.original: καὶ ἄλλα πρόβατα ἔχω ἃ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τῆς αὐλῆς ταύτης κἀκεῖνα δεῖ με ἀγαγεῖν καὶ τῆς φωνῆς μου ἀκούσουσιν καὶ γενήσονται μία ποίμνη εἷς ποιμήν
verses.transliteration: kai alla probata echō ha ouk estin ek tēs aulēs tautēs kakeina dei me agagein kai tēs phōnēs mou akousousin kai genēsontai mia poimnē heis poimēn
verses.literal: I have other sheep that are not of this fold I must bring them in as well and they will listen to My voice Then there will be one flock and one shepherd
verses.literalPt: Ainda tenho outras ovelhas que não são deste aprisco; também me convém agregar estas, e elas ouvirão a minha voz, e haverá um rebanho e um Pastor.

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτό με ὁ Πατὴρ ἀγαπᾷ ὅτι ἐγὼ τίθημι τὴν ψυχήν μου ἵνα πάλιν λάβω αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: Dia touto me ho Patēr agapa hoti egō tithēmi tēn psychēn mou hina palin labō autēn
verses.literal: The reason . . . the Father loves Me is that I lay down My life in order to take it up . . . again
verses.literalPt: Por isto o Pai me ama, porque dou a minha vida para tornar a tomá-la.

verses.original: οὐδεὶς αἴρει αὐτὴν ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ ἀλλ’ ἐγὼ τίθημι αὐτὴν ἀπ’ ἐμαυτοῦ ἐξουσίαν ἔχω θεῖναι αὐτήν καὶ ἐξουσίαν ἔχω πάλιν λαβεῖν αὐτήν ταύτην τὴν ἐντολὴν ἔλαβον παρὰ τοῦ Πατρός μου
verses.transliteration: oudeis airei autēn ap’ emou all’ egō tithēmi autēn ap’ emautou exousian echō theinai autēn kai exousian echō palin labein autēn tautēn tēn entolēn elabon para tou Patros mou
verses.literal: No one takes it from Me but I lay it down . . . of My own accord I have authority to lay it down . . . and authority to take it up . . . again This charge I have received from My Father
verses.literalPt: Ninguém ma tira de mim, mas eu de mim mesmo a dou; tenho poder para a dar, e poder para tornar a tomá-la. Este mandamento recebi de meu Pai.

verses.original: Σχίσμα πάλιν ἐγένετο ἐν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις διὰ τοὺς λόγους τούτους
verses.transliteration: Schisma palin egeneto en tois Ioudaiois dia tous logous toutous
verses.literal: Again there was division among the Jews because of Jesus’ message
verses.literalPt: Tornou, pois, a haver divisão entre os judeus por causa destas palavras.

verses.original: ἔλεγον δὲ πολλοὶ ἐξ αὐτῶν Δαιμόνιον ἔχει καὶ μαίνεται τί αὐτοῦ ἀκούετε
verses.transliteration: elegon de polloi ex autōn Daimonion echei kai mainetai ti autou akouete
verses.literal: Many of them said He is demon-possessed and insane Why would you listen to Him
verses.literalPt: E muitos deles diziam: Tem demônio, e está fora de si; por que o ouvis?

verses.original: Ἄλλοι ἔλεγον Ταῦτα τὰ ῥήματα οὐκ ἔστιν δαιμονιζομένου μὴ δαιμόνιον δύναται τυφλῶν ὀφθαλμοὺς ἀνοῖξαι
verses.transliteration: Alloi elegon Tauta ta rhēmata ouk estin daimonizomenou mē daimonion dynatai typhlōn ophthalmous anoixai
verses.literal: But others replied These are not the words of a man possessed by a demon Can a demon open the eyes of the blind
verses.literalPt: Diziam outros: Estas palavras não são de endemoninhado. Pode, porventura, um demônio abrir os olhos aos cegos?

verses.original: Ἐγένετο τότε τὰ ἐνκαίνια ἐν τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις χειμὼν ἦν
verses.transliteration: Egeneto tote ta enkainia en tois Hierosolymois cheimōn ēn
verses.literal: At that time the Feast of Dedication took place in Jerusalem It was winter
verses.literalPt: E em Jerusalém havia a festa da dedicação, e era inverno.

verses.original: καὶ περιεπάτει ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἐν τῇ στοᾷ τοῦ Σολομῶνος
verses.transliteration: kai periepatei ho Iēsous en tō hierō en tē stoa tou Solomōnos
verses.literal: and Jesus was walking in the temple courts in Solomon’s Colonnade
verses.literalPt: E Jesus andava passeando no templo, no alpendre de Salomão.

verses.original: ἐκύκλωσαν οὖν αὐτὸν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ ἔλεγον αὐτῷ Ἕως πότε τὴν ψυχὴν ἡμῶν αἴρεις εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστός εἰπὲ ἡμῖν παρρησίᾳ
verses.transliteration: ekyklōsan oun auton hoi Ioudaioi kai elegon autō Heōs pote tēn psychēn hēmōn aireis ei sy ei ho Christos eipe hēmin parrēsia
verses.literal: So the Jews gathered around Him and demanded How long . . . will You keep us in suspense . . . . . . . . . If You are the Christ tell us plainly
verses.literalPt: Rodearam-no, pois, os judeus, e disseram-lhe: Até quando terás a nossa alma suspensa? Se tu és o Cristo, dize-no-lo abertamente.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Εἶπον ὑμῖν καὶ οὐ πιστεύετε τὰ ἔργα ἃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Πατρός μου ταῦτα μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē autois ho Iēsous Eipon hymin kai ou pisteuete ta erga ha egō poiō en tō onomati tou Patros mou tauta martyrei peri emou
verses.literal: I already told you Jesus replied but you did not believe The works I do in - My Father’s name testify on My behalf
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Já vo-lo tenho dito, e não o credes. As obras que eu faço, em nome de meu Pai, essas testificam de mim.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ὑμεῖς οὐ πιστεύετε ὅτι οὐκ ἐστὲ ἐκ τῶν προβάτων τῶν ἐμῶν
verses.transliteration: alla hymeis ou pisteuete hoti ouk este ek tōn probatōn tōn emōn
verses.literal: But because you are not - My sheep you refuse to believe
verses.literalPt: Mas vós não credes porque não sois das minhas ovelhas, como já vo-lo tenho dito.

verses.original: τὰ πρόβατα τὰ ἐμὰ τῆς φωνῆς μου ἀκούουσιν κἀγὼ γινώσκω αὐτά καὶ ἀκολουθοῦσίν μοι
verses.transliteration: ta probata ta ema tēs phōnēs mou akouousin kagō ginōskō auta kai akolouthousin moi
verses.literal: My sheep listen to My voice I know them and they follow Me
verses.literalPt: As minhas ovelhas ouvem a minha voz, e eu conheço-as, e elas me seguem;

verses.original: κἀγὼ δίδωμι αὐτοῖς ζωὴν αἰώνιον καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀπόλωνται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ οὐχ ἁρπάσει τις αὐτὰ ἐκ τῆς χειρός μου
verses.transliteration: kagō didōmi autois zōēn aiōnion kai ou mē apolōntai eis ton aiōna kai ouch harpasei tis auta ek tēs cheiros mou
verses.literal: I give them eternal life and they will never perish . . . . . . . . . No one can snatch them out of My hand
verses.literalPt: E dou-lhes a vida eterna, e nunca hão de perecer, e ninguém as arrebatará da minha mão.

verses.original: ὁ Πατήρ μου ὃ δέδωκέν μοι πάντων μεῖζόν ἐστιν καὶ οὐδεὶς δύναται ἁρπάζειν ἐκ τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ Πατρός
verses.transliteration: ho Patēr mou ho dedōken moi pantōn meizon estin kai oudeis dynatai harpazein ek tēs cheiros tou Patros
verses.literal: My Father who has given them to Me is greater than all No one can snatch them out of My Father’s hand
verses.literalPt: Meu Pai, que mas deu, é maior do que todos; e ninguém pode arrebatá-las da mão de meu Pai.

verses.original: ἐγὼ καὶ ὁ Πατὴρ ἕν ἐσμεν
verses.transliteration: egō kai ho Patēr hen esmen
verses.literal: I and the Father are one
verses.literalPt: Eu e o Pai somos um.

verses.original: Ἐβάστασαν οὖν πάλιν λίθους οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἵνα λιθάσωσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Ebastasan oun palin lithous hoi Ioudaioi hina lithasōsin auton
verses.literal: At this the Jews again picked up stones to stone Him
verses.literalPt: Os judeus pegaram então outra vez em pedras para o apedrejar.

verses.original: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Πολλὰ ἔργα ἔδειξα ὑμῖν καλὰ ἐκ τοῦ Πατρός διὰ ποῖον αὐτῶν ἔργον ἐμὲ λιθάζετε
verses.transliteration: apekrithē autois ho Iēsous Polla erga edeixa hymin kala ek tou Patros dia poion autōn ergon eme lithazete
verses.literal: But Jesus responded I have shown you many good works from the Father For which of these do you stone Me
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Tenho-vos mostrado muitas obras boas procedentes de meu Pai; por qual destas obras me apedrejais?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι Περὶ καλοῦ ἔργου οὐ λιθάζομέν σε ἀλλὰ περὶ βλασφημίας καὶ ὅτι σὺ ἄνθρωπος ὢν ποιεῖς σεαυτὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: Apekrithēsan autō hoi Ioudaioi Peri kalou ergou ou lithazomen se alla peri blasphēmias kai hoti sy anthrōpos ōn poieis seauton Theon
verses.literal: We are not stoning You for any good work said the Jews but for blasphemy because You who are a man make Yourself out to be . . . God
verses.literalPt: Os judeus responderam, dizendo-lhe: Não te apedrejamos por alguma obra boa, mas pela blasfêmia; porque, sendo tu homem, te fazes Deus a ti mesmo.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Οὐκ ἔστιν γεγραμμένον ἐν τῷ νόμῳ ὑμῶν ὅτι Ἐγὼ εἶπα Θεοί ἐστε
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē autois ho Iēsous Ouk estin gegrammenon en tō nomō hymōn hoti Egō eipa Theoi este
verses.literal: Jesus replied Is it not written in your Law I have said you are gods
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Não está escrito na vossa lei: Eu disse: Sois deuses?

verses.original: εἰ ἐκείνους εἶπεν θεοὺς πρὸς οὓς ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐγένετο καὶ οὐ δύναται λυθῆναι ἡ γραφή
verses.transliteration: ei ekeinous eipen theous pros hous ho logos tou Theou egeneto kai ou dynatai lythēnai hē graphē
verses.literal: If he called them gods to whom the word of God came and the Scripture cannot be broken
verses.literalPt: Pois, se a lei chamou deuses àqueles a quem a palavra de Deus foi dirigida (e a Escritura não pode ser anulada),

verses.original: ὃν ὁ Πατὴρ ἡγίασεν καὶ ἀπέστειλεν εἰς τὸν κόσμον ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι Βλασφημεῖς ὅτι εἶπον Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰμι
verses.transliteration: hon ho Patēr hēgiasen kai apesteilen eis ton kosmon hymeis legete hoti Blasphēmeis hoti eipon Huios tou Theou eimi
verses.literal: then what about the One whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world How then can you accuse Me of blasphemy for stating that I am the Son of God
verses.literalPt: Àquele a quem o Pai santificou, e enviou ao mundo, vós dizeis: Blasfemas, porque disse: Sou Filho de Deus?

verses.original: Εἰ οὐ ποιῶ τὰ ἔργα τοῦ Πατρός μου μὴ πιστεύετέ μοι
verses.transliteration: Ei ou poiō ta erga tou Patros mou mē pisteuete moi
verses.literal: If I am not doing the works of My Father then do not believe Me
verses.literalPt: Se não faço as obras de meu Pai, não me acrediteis.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ ποιῶ κἂν ἐμοὶ μὴ πιστεύητε τοῖς ἔργοις πιστεύετε ἵνα γνῶτε καὶ γινώσκητε ὅτι ἐν ἐμοὶ ὁ Πατὴρ κἀγὼ ἐν τῷ Πατρί
verses.transliteration: ei de poiō kan emoi mē pisteuēte tois ergois pisteuete hina gnōte kai ginōskēte hoti en emoi ho Patēr kagō en tō Patri
verses.literal: But if I am doing them even though you do not believe Me believe the works themselves so that you may know and understand that the Father is in Me and I am in the Father
verses.literalPt: Mas, se as faço, e não credes em mim, crede nas obras; para que conheçais e acrediteis que o Pai está em mim e eu nele.

verses.original: Ἐζήτουν οὖν αὐτὸν πάλιν πιάσαι καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Ezētoun oun auton palin piasai kai exēlthen ek tēs cheiros autōn
verses.literal: At this they tried again to seize Him but He escaped . . . their grasp
verses.literalPt: Procuravam, pois, prendê-lo outra vez, mas ele escapou-se de suas mãos,

verses.original: Καὶ ἀπῆλθεν πάλιν πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου εἰς τὸν τόπον ὅπου ἦν Ἰωάννης τὸ πρῶτον βαπτίζων καὶ ἔμεινεν ἐκεῖ
verses.transliteration: Kai apēlthen palin peran tou Iordanou eis ton topon hopou ēn Iōannēs to prōton baptizōn kai emeinen ekei
verses.literal: Then Jesus went back across the Jordan to the place where John had first been baptizing and He stayed there
verses.literalPt: E retirou-se outra vez para além do Jordão, para o lugar onde João tinha primeiramente batizado; e ali ficou.

verses.original: καὶ πολλοὶ ἦλθον πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ ἔλεγον ὅτι Ἰωάννης μὲν σημεῖον ἐποίησεν οὐδέν πάντα δὲ ὅσα εἶπεν Ἰωάννης περὶ τούτου ἀληθῆ ἦν
verses.transliteration: kai polloi ēlthon pros auton kai elegon hoti Iōannēs men sēmeion epoiēsen ouden panta de hosa eipen Iōannēs peri toutou alēthē ēn
verses.literal: Many came to Him and said Although John never performed a sign everything he said about this man was true
verses.literalPt: E muitos iam ter com ele, e diziam: Na verdade João não fez sinal algum, mas tudo quanto João disse deste era verdade.

verses.original: καὶ πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ
verses.transliteration: kai polloi episteusan eis auton ekei
verses.literal: And many in that place believed in Jesus
verses.literalPt: E muitos ali creram nele.
